title: Neck Alignment
description: A guided protocol for restoring comfortable neck position and control.
landingHeadline: Release neck tension. Rebuild comfortable alignment.
landingSummary: Move beyond temporary stretching. This guided session helps you understand neck position, reduce unnecessary compensation, and practice control you can carry into daily life.
landingBenefit2: Reduce the shoulder tension that often accompanies poor neck position.
landingBenefit3: Build a repeatable alignment practice for work and everyday movement.
landingAudience: Designed for people dealing with desk-related stiffness, recurring postural tension, or a neck that never feels settled.
landingReassurance: One payment gives you protected access through your personal movement library—no subscription required.

title: Ankle Sprain Rehabilitation
description: A progressive guided session for rebuilding ankle mobility, balance, stability, and strength after the acute stage has settled.
landingHeadline: Rebuild ankle strength, stability, and trust.
landingSummary: A step-by-step rehabilitation session for rebuilding movement after an ankle sprain. Progress from mobility and control toward stability, strength, and greater confidence on the ankle.
landingBenefit1: Regain comfortable ankle mobility with controlled progressions.
landingBenefit2: Rebuild balance, stability, and foundational strength.
landingBenefit3: Develop confidence before returning to more demanding movement.
landingAudience: For people progressing beyond the acute stage of an ankle sprain who have been cleared for rehabilitation exercise.
landingReassurance: One payment provides protected access to the full progression. Stop and consult a clinician if pain or swelling increases.

title: Pelvic Balance
description: Build awareness and control around the pelvis using bodyweight drills.
landingHeadline: Build a stable pelvis—the base for better movement.
landingSummary: Your pelvis connects the upper and lower body. This bodyweight session develops awareness, balance, and control so the rest of your movement has a more stable foundation.
landingBenefit1: Recognize and adjust pelvic position with greater precision.
landingBenefit2: Build coordinated hip and trunk control.
landingBenefit3: Reduce avoidable compensations during everyday movement.
landingAudience: For anyone who feels uneven, disconnected through the hips, or unsure how pelvic position affects posture and movement.
landingReassurance: No equipment and no recurring fee—just a focused session available in your protected library.

title: Foot Mechanics
description: Practice foot pressure, stability, and movement from the ground up.
landingHeadline: Reconnect your feet to the ground.
landingSummary: Better movement starts with how your feet meet the floor. This concise session helps you practice pressure, stability, and control from the ground up.
landingBenefit1: Understand how to distribute pressure through the foot.
landingBenefit2: Build a steadier base for standing and walking.
landingBenefit3: Improve awareness of the foot-and-ankle connection.
landingAudience: For people who feel unstable, disconnected from the ground, or want stronger foundations before progressing to larger movements.
landingReassurance: A short, repeatable session with one-time purchase and protected personal access.

title: Walking Mechanics
description: Connect posture, balance, and rhythm in a practical walking session.
landingHeadline: Turn better alignment into a better walk.
landingSummary: Bring posture, balance, and rhythm together in motion. This practical session helps you translate isolated movement work into a smoother, more intentional walking pattern.
landingBenefit1: Practice balanced weight transfer from step to step.
landingBenefit2: Connect posture and rhythm while moving.
landingBenefit3: Build a walking pattern that feels more coordinated and confident.
landingAudience: For people ready to apply alignment and balance work to the movement they repeat most: walking.
landingReassurance: Buy once and return to the protected session as your walking practice develops.

title: Anterior Humeral Glide Fix
description: A complete guided session for shoulder positioning, control, and overhead capacity.
landingHeadline: Build stronger, more confident shoulder movement.
landingSummary: Follow one complete session that combines inhibition, activation, and integration to improve shoulder control and comfortable overhead movement.
landingBenefit1: Restore comfortable shoulder range and positioning.
landingBenefit2: Activate the muscles that support scapular control.
landingBenefit3: Integrate that control into stronger overhead movement.
landingAudience: For people who want a structured shoulder session instead of disconnected mobility drills.
landingReassurance: One payment gives you ongoing access to the complete guided session.

title: Bunion / Hallux Valgus Guide
description: A complete guided session for big-toe mobility, foot control, and more comfortable loading.
landingHeadline: Restore control from the big toe upward.
landingSummary: Use one complete session combining inhibition, activation, and integration to improve big-toe movement, foot control, and practical loading strategies.
landingBenefit2: Activate the intrinsic muscles that support foot control.
landingBenefit3: Integrate better toe control into standing and walking.
landingAudience: For people who want practical movement guidance for bunion or hallux valgus management.
landingReassurance: One payment gives you ongoing access to the complete guided session.
